what: Model-independent: no recognizer reads anything. For every row the selection scores it records the frames the C runtime gives it at a frame step of 8, 12 and 16 input columns, and NR, the frames CTC needs for its reference: characters plus one blank between adjacent repeated characters (eval/metrics.norm on the reference; the same floor train/train.py ctc_ok applies). A row with T_s < NR cannot be read exactly at stride s by any model; the protocol's tight stratum is T_s < 1.25 NR.
